figurative_meaning_bn: এত দুর্বল যে মাথা স্থির না থেকে নড়ে
figurative_meaning_en: So weak that the head cannot stay steady and shakes
example_sentences_in_bangla: রোগে ভুগে সে নন্নড়ে হয়ে পড়েছে।
ভাত খেয়ে উঠতেই নন্নড়ে অবস্থা হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: He has become so weak from illness that his head is shaking uncontrollably.
After eating, he felt so feeble that his head started wobbling.
note: This idiom uses onomatopoeia to mimic the shaking motion, common in rural Bengali dialects.
